title: hev.attention.event/v1
description: One attention notice (docs/notify.md): a moment a person must look at a dispatch run, orchestrator, expediter, swarm or steer, or the opt-in ready and done kinds. Kit emits it on the host where it happens. hev-hook-NAME handlers on PATH receive it whole on stdin as the run-lifecycle event named by `event` (argument and HEV_HOOK_EVENT; HEV_HOOK_HARNESS is kit). Handler output is ignored. The same record is what [notify.slack] posts and what a pulled owner receipt carries.

id.description: Stable ID derived from what the notice is about (source, host, name, kind and the moment's key: for needs-you its subject, the run or orchestrator plus the decision key and question or the halt; otherwise the attempt), never from when it was emitted. A re-emitted notice with the same ID is not handled again.

time.description: When this host first emitted it.

event.description: The kind. needs-you: only an open decision (a run ended needs-decision KEY: QUESTION, or an orchestrator, expedite or swarm [needs you] needs-decision KEY: QUESTION) or a steering halt escalated to a hard stop; an unchanged subject is not raised again. ready: an orchestrator met its goal, or a run's PR is ready with green CI and a PASS review. done (opt-in): a run ended done, failed, timeout, blocked or needs-review, a queued run failed admission, a repeat ended, an orchestrator stopped or stalled, or a [needs you] reply that is not a decision.

name.description: The dispatch run or orchestrator name.

host.description: The host it happened on, as the dispatch config names it.

state.description: The run or orchestrator state, e.g. needs-review, blocked, failed, stalled, complete.

text.description: One line, whitespace collapsed and credentials redacted. Empty for client hosts.

pr.description: Pull request URL; omitted for client hosts.

run.description: Command that shows the run or orchestrator, e.g. hev dispatch show NAME --host HOST.

board.description: Board entry URL; never its body. Omitted for client hosts.

thread.description: Groups notices of one run (with its steers) or one orchestrator into one Slack thread: run:HOST/NAME or orchestrator:HOST/NAME.

client.description: Emitted on a client host ([notify] client = true): delivery names only the run or orchestrator and its state.

requested_by.description: Who the run, orchestrator or expediter works for. Kit sets it on every notice it emits (absent only on receipts from hosts older than this field). Reworks keep it; validators and reviews take their source run's; a run dispatched by an orchestrator, or from inside another run's worktree, takes that orchestrator's or run's.

person.description: The hosted (Clerk) user ID, author.id from /v1/whoami, when the emitting host is signed in to a kit service and the requester is a local sender; otherwise the run's sender: local:ACCOUNT or a nodes teammate name.

name.description: Display name: the signed-in author's name, else the sender.

addressee.description: Persons (as in requested_by.person) or roles the notice asks. Defaults to [requested_by.person]. Delivery does not depend on it: [notify.slack] posts to the host's configured channel.
